title: Safety Training Plan
description: Free Safety Training Plan template you can edit online and download as PDF. Covers training needs analysis, training schedule, competence and records.

Competence And Records

1. Training is delivered by a competent trainer and recorded with date, content, trainer and

attendee signature.

2. Effectiveness is verified by observation, assessment or questioning after the training.

3. Certificates and expiry dates are tracked, and workers do not perform tasks needing a

certificate once it has expired.
